# What SoftwareDLC is

Reference ID: `what-is-softwaredlc` · Version: 2026-10-09 · Topics: overview, value

An overview of SoftwareDLC as a connected Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) system and the value it provides across product and engineering work.

## System purpose

Section ID: `system-purpose` (overview)

SoftwareDLC keeps product intent, system design, implementation structure, and change history connected.
Durable relationships live in one system graph and are projected into focused views for different roles.

## Product value

Section ID: `product-value` (principles)

Continuity preserves why a capability exists, who it serves, how it is implemented, what changed, and what evidence supports acceptance.
AI collaborators use the same explicit model as people rather than inventing a separate private representation.
The graph may begin sparse and become richer as durable claims emerge through every phase: plan, design, implement, test, release, and maintain.
